er_dual_plaque_desc: 1×1。橱窗陈列时，每个营业日有50%机会引荐1位上层买家，最短间隔2天。
1×1. While displayed, each business day has a 50% chance to refer one Upper Level customer; minimum 2 days apart.
er_dual_plaque_flavor: 底座背面刻着一行小字：莉迪亚，替朋友说话。
A small line is engraved on the back: Lydia, speaking up for a friend.
er_dual_biz_second_intro: 莉迪亚说你能找到便携净水器。预算 {0} 信用点，耐久至少要有 {1}。东西先给我看，价钱照常谈。
Lydia said you can find a portable water purifier. Budget {0} credits, at least {1} durability. Show me the item first; we'll negotiate the price normally.
er_dual_plaque_full: 橱窗已满，奖励保留，可稍后补领。
Showcase full. The reward is kept for a later claim.
er_dual_entry_resume: This conversation is not finished yet.
er_dual_notice_ending: 三人关系已稳定，日常来访继续。
The three of you are steady. Everyday visits continue.
er_dual_gate_passed: 上层区声望达到{0}，奖励已解锁。
Upper Level reputation reached {0}. Reward unlocked.
er_dual_claim_line: 这个替你收着呢——{0}。这次腾出地方了吧？
I have been keeping this for you: {0}. Have you made room this time?
er_dual_perfume_claim: 那瓶香水还替你留着。这次拿好。
I still have that perfume for you. Take it this time.
er_dual_referral_intro: 莉迪亚提起过这家店。我想看看适合带回上层的东西，价钱照常谈。
Lydia mentioned this shop. I would like to see something suitable for the Upper Levels. We can negotiate as usual.
er_dual_referral_close: 今天就到这里。东西合适，我还会再来。
That will do for today. If the goods suit me, I will return.
er_dual_patron_desc: 1×1。橱窗陈列时，上层顾客最终预算+30%。
1×1. While displayed, Upper Level customers get +30% final budget.
er_dual_patron_flavor: 她说这只是个摆件，却替你把底座擦得很亮。
She calls it a trinket, yet polishes its base for you.
er_dual_gratitude_desc: 1×1。橱窗陈列时，上层顾客实际付款后额外给10%小费，每次最多150。
1×1. While displayed, Upper Level customers pay an extra 10% tip after a real purchase, up to 150 per visit.
er_dual_gratitude_flavor: 底座上的字很小：承蒙照应。
Tiny words on the base: With thanks for your care.
er_gala_not_attend_desc: 明确谢绝本次邀请，不再另约下一场；关系不变。
Decline this invitation without arranging another party. Your relationship is unchanged.
er_dual_resolution_ack: All right. Then that is what we have agreed.
er_dual_future_schema: 后宫扩展存档版本{0}高于本版本，已暂停该扩展写入；现有数据保留。
Harem save schema {0} is newer than this version. Extension writes are paused; existing data is preserved.
er_dual_trade_close_bought: 这几件我带走。账照算，别因为是我来，就少收。
I'll take these. Bill them properly. Don't undercharge just because it's me.
er_dual_trade_close_none: 今天没有合眼的。下回收到好货，记得给我留一件。
Nothing caught my eye today. Next time you get something good, remember to hold one for me.
